episodes.title: We Have Always Lived in the Castle
episodes.summary: As her husband faces scrutiny for his past affairs with students, M finds herself drawn to Vladimir, her captivating — and much younger — new colleague.

episodes.title: The Awakening
episodes.summary: M resorts to drastic measures to get John's hearing delayed, as cocktails and campus chats deepen her bond with Vlad.

episodes.title: Enormous Changes at the Last Minute
episodes.summary: M tries to ingratiate herself with Cynthia by hosting a pool party. Sid comes clean with her parents about what's really going on.

episodes.title: Bad Behavior
episodes.summary: Sid joins on to support John's case. M resorts to desperate measures to delay a hearing and has a surprisingly frank conversation with Cynthia.

episodes.title: Play It As It Lays
episodes.summary: M ponders an ambiguous emoji and plots a meeting with an ulterior motive. Sid's attempt to defuse Lila's testimony quickly goes south.

episodes.title: Because It Is Bitter and Because It Is My Heart
episodes.summary: Facing fallout from John's indiscretions and the cold shoulder from her colleagues, M takes her case directly to the student body.

episodes.title: Everything That Rises Must Converge
episodes.summary: M finally gets her chance to be alone with Vlad — and finds herself in over her head when she doesn't want their lunch date to end.

episodes.title: Against Interpretation
episodes.summary: A retreat to the countryside gets complicated as M and Vlad contemplate their writing, their marriages and their wildly uncertain futures.
